title: SONG PAL
style: Phonk-country club mix with a stomping half-time groove, dusty kick claps, distorted 808 slides, and twangy banjo riffs trading with chopped vocal chants; verse stays sparse and swaggering, pre-chorus strips to handclaps and a rising whistle, chorus hits with gang shouts and a bass drop, then a breakdown cycles the hook through each country. Close-mic lead with pitched doubles, call-and-response chants, delay throws on the title phrase. Bright, gritty, and wide., country, world
